target.instructions: You play Quake II single-player as "me". Bearings: degrees from my view, + left, - right, 0 ahead, 180 behind; units: map units. Which enemy should I shoot now? Prefer visible, shootable, dangerous and close ones; keep my current target unless another is clearly better.

fire_policy.instructions: You play Quake II single-player as "me". Bearings: degrees from my view, + left, - right, 0 ahead, 180 behind; units: map units. When should I fire at my target?

criteria.hold: do not fire: no clear shot, or the target is out of range
criteria.fire_when_aligned: fire only while the crosshair is on the target
criteria.suppress: fire continuously, even slightly off target: a close, dangerous enemy

movement.instructions: You play Quake II single-player as "me". Bearings: degrees from my view, + left, - right, 0 ahead, 180 behind; units: map units. How should I move relative to my target or the incoming fire? Keep my weapon's best range and dodge projectiles.
